description: A shell library for testing credential helpers, including functions for checking, rejecting, and testing various credential helper behaviors, as well as a script for simulating an askpass prompt.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Function to test credential helper commands with expected stdin, stdout, and stderr.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads lines from input until a '--' line is encountered, outputting each line.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Cleans residual data from previous tests by rejecting various credentials.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects specific credentials for a given helper.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Runs a series of tests on a specified credential helper, including storing, retrieving, overwriting, and deleting credentials.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script for simulating an askpass prompt.
